title: Check a member or principal reference in the caller's tenant
description: TenantReferenceQuery (multi-tenant BRX-TENANT-CONTRACT-003, T-7). The tenant is the caller's, from the runtime; the request carries none. refKind is explicit because a member and a principal may have the same id. x-brix-classification marks each field (root BRX-RS-SECURITY-008).

refId.description: the member id or principal id the plugin stores

refKind.description: whether refId names a staff member or a principal (an end customer)
